title: Backlog-era live instructions remain in lore-cli docs after LCLI-574
description: Found by the LCLI-574 implementer's sweep of docs/ (opum-ai/lore-cli#272). These are live instructions, not history, and were outside LCLI-574's two target passages: (1) docs/runbooks/lore-cli-handover.md:25 says 'Start at the documentation index', and the whole runbook is from the Backlog era ('backlog instructions overview', 'the Backlog CLI'). It needs a rewrite against Quest and the opum-handoff skill, or a retirement. (2) docs/reference/operate-autonomous-lore-cli-documentation-campaigns.md:76 says '$backlog-handover restore', and :81 names the opum-worktrees skill, which was deleted 2026-09-04; parts of it assume Backlog throughout. (3) docs/runbooks/agent-onboarding.md's quick-reference row says 'lore link ... lore commits' (true only on Backlog, per LCLI-573), and two places say it 'drives backlog --json'. Retirement scope applies: fix live instruction, leave dated history alone.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Each listed passage either describes current behaviour (Quest backend, opum-handoff, no lore commits on Quest) or is removed as retired, verified against source or lore instructions
A grep of docs/ for backlog-handover, opum-worktrees and backlog --json returns only history or product-surface hits, each listed in the PR body

plan: Verify per-backend behaviour in src/: tracker selection (src/tracker-selection.ts), commit decision (src/tracker-persistence.ts, src/commands/link.ts commitFileFor), what lore tasks invokes per adapter (src/adapters/quest.ts, backlog.ts, jira.ts), init's tracker probe (src/commands/init.ts)

Rewrite docs/runbooks/lore-cli-handover.md in place as a short pointer to opum-handoff restore against Quest; keep the path so its six inbound links stay true (lore graph shows they all describe it as a cursor-free fresh-session route)

Rewrite the Backlog/Codex-era parts of docs/reference/operate-autonomous-lore-cli-documentation-campaigns.md: authority source, delegation roles, opum-handoff init/restore/cursor, plain branch plus explicit isolation parameter, drop retired lease and cursor-audit limits
Make docs/runbooks/agent-onboarding.md backend-accurate: loop diagram, Step 3, init probe, 2.3/2.4, guardrails, quick-reference rows and Related list; leave Backlog product-surface links intact
Run /usr/bin/grep -rn over docs/ for backlog-handover, opum-worktrees and 'backlog --json'; classify every hit and count files scanned
Run bun run lore sync if needed and bun run lore check to exit 0; commit, push, record evidence and final summary
